earnings.title: ENTEGRIS REPORTS RESULTS FOR THIRD QUARTER OF 2026
highlights: Gross margin - as a % of net sales 49.7 % 43.5 % 47.6 %

quotes.text: Entegris is executing well against an attractive long-term opportunity, driven by increasing semiconductor complexity, rising materials intensity, and investment in leading-edge technologies.

outlook: For the Company’s guidance for the fourth quarter ending December 31, 2026, the Company expects sales of $1,025 million to $1,055 million.
The Company expects GAAP net income to be between $168 million and $181 million and diluted earnings per common share is expected to be between $1.09 and $1.17.
On a non-GAAP basis, the Company expects diluted earnings per common share to range from $1.32 to $1.40, reflecting net income on a non-GAAP basis in the range of $203 million to $215 million.
The Company also expects Adjusted EBITDA of approximately 30.7% to 31.2% of sales.

items.heading: Our revenue is primarily dependent upon demand from the global semiconductor ecosystem. Fluctuations in demand, whether from industry cyclicality, changes in consumer spending, macroeconomic conditions, or other factors, may cause our revenues and operating results to vary significantly, which could adversely affect our business.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry

items.heading: As a result of global economic uncertainty, we may experience reduced demand for our products, increased costs, challenges in forecasting our operating results and identifying and prioritizing business risks, and other negative effects, any of which may materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry

items.heading: Interruptions in our supply chain, including those from our sole, single and limited source suppliers, could affect our ability to manufacture our products and meet demand, which, in turn, could have an adverse effect on our revenue and results of operations.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry

items.heading: Because a significant amount of our sales and manufacturing activity occurs outside the U.S., we are exposed to risks inherent in operating a global business, including changes in economic policy, geopolitical tensions and challenges in managing a diverse workforce and operating under differing business and legal environments, which may harm our reputation or profitability.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry

items.heading: Export controls, economic sanctions, and other similar restrictions may limit our ability to sell our products to certain customers, require us to obtain governmental licenses, put the Company at a competitive disadvantage both domestically and internationally and expose us to additional legal liability, all of which could harm our business and financial condition.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry

items.heading: A significant portion of our sales is concentrated on a limited number of key customers, and our net sales and profitability may materially decline if we were to lose one or more of these customers.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry
